title: OpenRouter API Reference: Overview
claim: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer; request model (vendor-prefixed) and messages; response choices[] and usage (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost); normalizes the schema across models and providers; unsupported parameters are ignored; finish_reason normalized.

title: Gemini API: OpenAI compatibility
claim: Base URL https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/; key as Authorization: Bearer in REST; chat completions, structured output supported; support is still in beta; Gemini-specific options in extra_body.

title: Anthropic: OpenAI SDK compatibility
claim: Base URL https://api.anthropic.com/v1/; primarily intended to test and compare model capabilities, not a long-term or production-ready solution for most use cases; n must be 1; response_format accepts only json_schema with strict true; many fields ignored; response read as choices[0].message.content.

title: DeepSeek API Docs (quick start)
claim: Base URL https://api.deepseek.com, an API format compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic; POST /chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer and a body of model, messages, stream.

title: Moonshot / Kimi API: Chat Completions
claim: POST /v1/chat/completions on https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 with a Bearer key; response_format text/json_object/json_schema; response choices[].message.content plus reasoning_content; usage with prompt/completion/total tokens; does not claim full compatibility.

title: OpenAI: Structured Outputs guide
claim: JSON mode ensures valid JSON but not schema adherence; only Structured Outputs (json_schema, strict true) ensure schema adherence; the application still needs to handle refusals, incomplete responses and API errors; business rules a schema cannot express need separate validation. First 100000 of about 151840 characters read.

title: OpenRouter: Structured Outputs
claim: response_format json_schema is supported by select models; support is determined per endpoint, not just per model, and changes over time; some providers treat the schema as a strong hint, so exact compliance is not guaranteed on every endpoint; require_parameters true routes only to supporting endpoints.

title: OpenRouter: Provider Routing
claim: provider.require_parameters is a boolean defaulting to false: 'Only use providers that support all parameters in your request.' Without it, providers lacking a parameter ignore it and the request proceeds (rechecked by the decider 2026-11-21: the default verbatim; the ignore behaviour from a page summary, not a verbatim quote).

title: OpenRouter: Response Healing plugin
claim: Opt-in plugin repairing malformed JSON (brackets, commas, quotes, fences, preceding prose) for non-streaming json_schema or json_object requests; cannot repair output truncated by the token limit.

title: Zheng et al. 2023, Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
claim: Position, verbosity and self-enhancement biases; 'GPT-4 favors itself with a 10% higher win rate; Claude-v1 favors itself with a 25% higher win rate'; 'our study cannot determine whether the models exhibit a self-enhancement bias' (both quotes rechecked verbatim by the decider 2026-11-21).

title: Panickssery et al. 2024, LLM Evaluators Recognize and Favor Their Own Generations
claim: Abstract read: evaluators score their own outputs higher than humans rate them; models recognize their own text with non-trivial accuracy; fine-tuning shows a linear correlation between self-recognition and self-preference, suggested causal.

title: OpenRouter model catalogue, read 2026-11-21
claim: GET returned the ids moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro, google/gemini-4-argon, z-ai/glm-5.3 and deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash (the host model map's check and volume models) as present.
